plainLanguage: Corpus Christi uses the 2021 IRC with city amendments. Every new house needs a foundation design stamped by a Texas engineer and windstorm plans stamped by a TDI-certified windstorm engineer. The city is in the Texas windstorm area: since April 1, 2026 homes are designed to the 2024 IRC as adopted by TDI at about 150 mph, with impact-rated windows and doors, and a TDI WPI-8 certificate is needed for windstorm insurance. In flood zone AE the floor must be at least 1 ft above the base flood elevation; in V zones the house goes on piles with the lowest beam 1 ft above it. A typical RS-6 lot is 6,000 sq ft with about 25 ft front, 5 ft side and 20 ft rear setbacks and a 35 ft height limit (confirm against the UDC). City permit plus plan review is about $1,700 for a 2,400 sq ft home with garage.
